speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are a neonate presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth. To help me understand your condition, please tell me if you were born prematurely or if your mother had any specific infections during pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sepsis (likely Group B Streptococcus) leading to neonatal encephalopathy.
